name: core
description: CORE is a project intelligence agent that knows your project across sessions, surfaces decisions and risks proactively, and challenges overconfidence. Single agent with a unit-based memory architecture, retrieval ladder, and rendered project synthesis; reaches for multi-agent adversarial analysis when stakes warrant. Use CORE for project work where continuity matters: ongoing development, architecture decisions, risk surfacing, decision tracking. Ships with five companion utilities (finalize, process-memory, register-sources, vibecheck, configure-project) that CORE invokes internally and can be invoked directly.

interface.shortDescription: Project intelligence with a critic baked in
interface.longDescription: CORE is a single agent that knows your project across sessions. It maintains a unit-based memory architecture in your project folder, renders a six-section project synthesis (state, people, moves, decisions and risks), surfaces decisions and risks proactively, and challenges overconfidence. When stakes warrant, it reaches for multi-agent adversarial analysis with explicit anti-convergence discipline. Ships with five companion utilities (/finalize, /process-memory, /register-sources, /vibecheck, /configure-project) that CORE invokes internally and that you can also call directly.
defaultPrompt: Where do things stand on this project?
What were the open risks last session?
Pick up where we left off.
